title: Quarry Enchantment
description: Quarry enchantment that allows you to mine more blocks at a time
body: This mod allows you to mine more of the space around you with a custom enchant that can be added via a book command or enchant table. Supports up to quarry V. Works with forture, and silk touch. Also works underwater. Mod is still in Beta please comment issues and problems and i will work on them as I can. Yes i know it can be added to swords but it doesnt do anything, It also needs some work done on the outline to show you where you are mining but for now its a good start. DOWNLOAD AT YOUR OWN RISK. IT IS A FPS HOG SO BE CAREFUL. I also fixed the audio bugs already so everything should work.
